glosses: cloud (mass of dust, steam or smoke)

examples.text: A lua está atrás das nuvens.
examples.en: The moon is behind the clouds.

examples.text: Não há nenhuma nuvem no céu.
examples.en: There's not a cloud in the sky.

examples.text: O vento levou as nuvens embora.
examples.en: The clouds were driven away by the wind.

examples.text: Há mais nuvens hoje do que ontem.
examples.en: There are more clouds today than yesterday.

examples.text: A lua veio por de trás da nuvem.
examples.en: The moon came out from behind the cloud.
